## Community Watch: Fraud Safety


What happens when you or someone you love is targeted by a fraudulent email, computer pop-up, or text message? There is an urgency that causes confusion and rash decisions. We’ve all been there, but we don’t always know what to do.


Listen to our latest podcast episode as Sherrie Huber, VNB's fraud expert, Chief Operations Officer, and Audit Manager, talks with Sherry Taylor, podcast host and voice of VNB, to provide detailed information on how to look out for red flags and avoid fraud.


*Find to the interview link below and follow **“Virginia National Bank: My Forever Bank”** podcast show wherever you listen to podcasts.*
